text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this? It's my personal rule, number 
18! If I come up with a mile haiku while 
taking a morning bath, I have to do 
Umamusume yoga!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—That's how it is, but I didn't have time 
this morning because of day duty.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm working on it right now. My 
personal rules are very important, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Next up is~~... The yoga pose of a kitty 
cat at the racetrack♪
